site: Any form; seen on the OPT / STEM-OPT question
class: The first saved answer whose pattern matched answered the question, not the most specific one
symptom: 'Are you currently in a pre or post completion OPT ...?' was answered 'Graduated' (from re:status) although the owner saved 'No' for exactly that question.
root_cause: library_answer returned the first key in data/profile_answers.json that matched; the broad re:status came before the OPT pattern.
why_tests_missed: Saved-answer tests each had one matching key; none had two keys matching the same question.
fix: library_answer ranks every match: an exact saved question first, then the pattern whose match covers the most of the question.
prevention: Never let file order decide between matches; rank by specificity and test with competing keys.
